parsed.name: USBTMC通信组件
parsed.description: 用于实验系统与支持 USBTMC 的测试测量仪器之间进行读写通信的非实体通信组件。它封装了基于 USBTMC 的连接，提供地址、终止符、超时等属性管理，以及文本和原始字节的读取、写入与连接关闭等文件式 I/O 操作。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical communication component used to read from and write to USBTMC-compatible test and measurement instruments in laboratory systems. It wraps a USBTMC connection and provides property management for address, terminator, and timeout, along with file-like I/O operations such as text/raw byte read, write, and connection close.
